section.content: 在有多个实现预定功能的集成电路块的半导体集成电路中，高效率地进行集成电路块的全部功能动作测试，并且可抑制常规模式时和测试模式时的电路动作速度的下降。在集成电路块的第一输出端和集成电路块的第一输入端之间仅插入用于信号选择的多路转换器，在集成电路块的第二输出端和集成电路块的第二输入端之间仅插入多路转换器，所以可以降低信号延迟。此外，在触发电路之间仅插入多路转换器，因而可以减少信号延迟。

The invention is to obtain a semiconductor integrated circuit having a plurality of integrated circuit blocks for realizing a specified function in which function test is performed efficiently for all integrated circuit blocks while suppressing lowering in the operating speed of circuit in normal mode and test mode. Since the signal transmission path between integrated circuit blocks is not provided with a flip-flop circuit, a random logic circuit, or the like, but only multiplexers are provided, respectively, between the first output terminal of the circuit block and the first input terminal of the circuit block and between the second output terminal of the circuit block and the second input terminal of the circuit block, signal delay is suppressed.

SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit)Technical field

The present invention relates to SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit), particularly improve the SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) of the function action testing efficiency of a plurality of integrated circuit blocks of realizing predetermined function.

Background technology

In recent years, because the progress of extensiveization of SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit), thereby in SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit), can load the integrated circuit block of realizing various functions by multiple load mode.These integrated circuit blocks interconnect, and realize the function as a SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit).These SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) are furnished with a plurality of input terminals and a plurality of lead-out terminal with external interface.

In addition, integrated circuit block also is furnished with and is used for carrying out in SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) inside interconnective a plurality of input wirings and a plurality of output is connected up.But integrated circuit block can not be directly controlled on input terminal that SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) has and lead-out terminal and is observed.

Wherein, as the device of confirming the integrated circuit block function, input wiring that input terminal and lead-out terminal with SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) directly be connected each integrated circuit block and the device in the output wiring are arranged, but essential a plurality of traffic pilots and a plurality of wiring, thereby the circuit scale of SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) is greatly increased.
